arStrings.szText: {c_important}Counterattack's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_8}|1|]{/c} seconds per stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} you have.
{c_important}Counterattack's{/c} Passive reduces Damage Over Time effects on you by {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|%|]{/c}.
When you Dodge a Control Impairing attack with {c_important}Counterattack{/c} it will reflect that Crowd Control to all Close enemies for {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Counterattack's{/c} Passive now also retaliates against all Close enemies for {c_number}{payload:PARRY_IMPACT_B}{/c} damage when you Dodge any attack.

{c_important}Counterattack{/c} becomes a {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skill that deals Poison damage.

{c_label}Passive:{/c} Your {c_important}{u}Pestilent Swarms{/u}{/c} {c_important}{u}Weaken{/u}{/c} enemies.

{c_label}Active:{/c} Send out {c_number}[SF_22]{/c} {c_important}{u}Pestilent Swarms{/u}{/c} that deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage each second for {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} seconds.
